title: Great tour and value
text: We loved this experience!  We were able to get on and off easily at stops that were more of an interest to us.  The fee was very reasonable considering the length of the tour and that it's guided.  They do provide ear buds for you too.  The staff were very friendly and answered questions for us.  The crowd was a good size, but there was room for everyone.  It was a good time and a warm day so we did enjoy the seats on the top with the open roof.  I'd recommend this tour for anyone!  We did the 24hour tour.  Next time I'd choose the 48hour tour if time permitted.  It would allow for more time a

author: Heather_S

title: Sightseeing bus
text: We thoroughly enjoyed the sightseeing bus tour around Barcelona, It was a fantastic way to see the city, take in the major attractions and experience the different areas without having to walk long distances. The views from the bus were great, and it gave us a good overview of Barcelona and its many highlights. It was convenient, comfortable and a relaxing way to explore, especially for visitors who are unfamiliar with the city. The tour was well worth doing and I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona who wants to see more of the city.
author: Franco

title: Awesome Tour
text: The Sagrada Familia is spectacular! You don't want to miss it! Our tour guide was great, very knowledgeable and explained things well! Highly recommend this tour! A blessing for sure.
author: Tony_L

title: Highly recommend
text: This is such a fabulous way to see Barcelona!  I told several people in our group about it and they all purchased passes as well.   The buses are clean, the host is friendly and you can listen to the tour in 8 different languages.  You decide which attractions you want to hop off and see and which ones to pass by.  And with the 48 hour pass, there was plenty of time to see everything.  So glad we did it.
author: Carol_M
